name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - § 5/1
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘the twin transition’
part_context: Welcomes the significant reinforcement of the policies included in heading 2, in line with Parliament’s long-standing calls, which represents a doubling compared to the current period and which will better equip the Union to respond to future challenges in an increasingly unpredictable global environment; recognises the need to reinforce the Union’s capacity to act in key strategic areas, including competitiveness, defence and security, research and innovation, <del>the twin transition</del>, infrastructure, health and crisis preparedness, education and culture;
